title: Historical Lower Town Neighborhoods et Grand Marché Bike Tour
includes: Small bike bag installed on your handlebars for personal belongings
Choice of Urban Bike or E-Bike (E-Bike: at least 18 years old)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be able to ride a bike approximately 8 miles by themselves. Children between 5 and 7 will use a trail-a-bike pulled by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Lower Town Historical Bike Tour is fantastic introduction to Quebec City and its surroundings. It reveals many hidden gems and all the must visits; Place Royal, the Mural des Québécois and Notre-Dames-des-Victoires. Meander along the green lush banks of the Saint Charles River. Your dynamic qualified tour guide will explain intriguing facts about the diverse artistic neighborhoods; Limoilou with its unique colorful spiral staircases. Stop at the “Grand Marché”, have the chance to mingle with finest local artisans producers. This is the perfect tour for your first time exploring the city!
